In 1954, a woman was taking a nap on her couch when she was hit by a rock from space.
Ann Hodges lived in a small house in Sylacauga, Alabama.
On November thirtieth, people all over town saw a bright fireball in the sky.
Then something crashed through Ann's roof.
It was a meteorite the size of a grapefruit. It bounced off her radio, and slammed into her hip.
It left a bruise the size of a pineapple.
She is the first person in history confirmed to have been hit by a meteorite.
The Air Force came and took the rock away for testing.
Then her landlady said the meteorite was hers, because it fell on her house.
They fought over it for months. Finally, Ann paid her five hundred dollars to keep it.
But by then, people had lost interest, and nobody wanted to buy it.
So Ann gave it to a museum in Alabama, where you can still see it today.
